film.author: 街景写生达人
film.title: 康定东路20号，原大任小学既幼稚园。钢笔水彩速写写生。
film.reproduction: Measurements only. The author’s pixels are not embedded in the mesh or comparison views.

edge_method: An observer first located the opening between the red arch and the darker reveal on the video. 51 trial locations follow an arc. Directional red/grey gradients within 3.1 native pixels of the initial contour supplied 39 supported points per opening. The residual is a fitted error in this image; it is not an independent metric accuracy.
sources_for_sashes: Public 2015-12 and 2020-02 street panoramas. See street-front-cameras.json for camera identity. Tangential intensity profiles of the visible glazing bars in the centre and both east views were compared on parallel planes. Some windows are covered by the terrace, trees, or changed glazing. Peaks near the search boundary or on foreground objects are unreliable.

sill_band_survey.mean_luminance: 0.23R + 0.59G + 0.18B. Three channels sampled at 135 pixels per metre after registration. The central 73 percent of each width is used. Median over X, Gaussian at 1.5 samples, then opposing extrema around the brightest sill strip provide its top and underside.
sill_band_survey.excluded_obstructions: Opening 1 is hidden by a foreground trunk in the 2020 centre view. Windows 11–14 are behind foliage at the eastern 2020 station. Visible video profiles are compared to the left or right unobstructed 2020 station. The 2015 images are independent observations and generally read 4–10 cm higher.
